summary: Inline create/edit panels moved onto dedicated routes: financial records, deadlines (create + edit) and document templates (create + edit). Role pass complete. Handshake release id deliberately unchanged.
changes: Gated the raw write-button long tail: 9 groups across 5 pages
Found and gated 2 ungated writes in configuration/templates the handover never listed
Declared 5 previously undeclared packages in package.json and package-lock.json
Converted the financial-records create panel to /financial-records/new (1229 -> 566 lines)
Converted the deadlines create panel to /deadlines/new
Converted the deadlines edit panel to /deadlines/[id]/edit (749 -> 322 lines)
Added deadlinesApi.retrieve for single-deadline reads on the edit route
Fixed a U+FFFD mojibake in the deadline description placeholder
Removed a dead EmptyState action that would have leaked a create button to Directors
Added 3 guard tests (manifest, raw-write gate, route conversions), each proven failing on v17.13
Converted the document-templates editor to /configuration/templates/new and /[id]/edit (1235 -> 610 lines)
Spliced the 345-line field-builder markup into TemplateBuilderForm.tsx byte-for-byte
Fixed the third entry point: new-version now navigates to the fresh draft instead of opening a panel
Edit route refuses published templates instead of rendering an unsavable form
Conversion guard gained an audited allowLeftover exemption plus a 7th test that makes exemptions cost something
Replaced 12 hand-copied guide panels with a shared GuidePanel component (256 lines removed, 72 strings verified)
Added guide-panel-contract.test.ts, including an assertion that every prop stays translated
Documented and fixed a restore hazard: the node_modules tarball overwrites package.json and package-lock.json
Retired Treasury and Personnel Reports from the sidebar via RETIRED_ROUTES; API deliberately unchanged
Inverted the navigation test that required both modules to be present, and added a vacuity guard

v17.19: ExportableListMixin wired into 6 list endpoints (deadlines, financial records, clients, suppliers, cash transfers, companies) after being dead code; fixed its unusable ?format= parameter (DRF reserves the name) and corrected a docstring that blamed a non-existent personnel bug. Backend 1310 -> 1322 tests.
Added a shared ExportButton and a single list-export client for all six export endpoints
Put export buttons on the Deadlines, Financial Records, Companies and Cash Transfers list screens
Exports send the screen's own filters, so the file matches what is on screen
Export stays outside WriteOnly: exporting is a read, and Directors may read
Strengthened the write-gate guard to assert position inside WriteOnly instead of matching a literal string
Added export-wiring-contract.test.ts (8 tests) pinning output_format, blob responses and the ungated button
Corrected section 5 of the handover, which still listed shipped items 1, 2 and 6 as pending
v17.21: Treasury endpoints restricted to Administrator (and superuser) for read, write and delete.
v17.21: Personnel report endpoints restricted to Administrator via a fail-closed CanGenerateReports.
v17.21: RETIRED_ROUTES emptied; Treasury and Personnel Reports return to the sidebar for Administrators only.
v17.21: New 7-test admin-only module contract, proven failing against the previous permissions.
v17.22: Fixed the two react-hooks/set-state-in-effect errors on the personnel reports page; ESLint now reports 0 errors.
v17.22: Shared EntitySection gained an optional exportKey prop rendering the standard ExportButton.
v17.22: Clients and suppliers list exports wired, completing all six v17.19 export endpoints.
v17.22: Two new export-wiring guard tests covering shared-component exports (frontend 123 -> 125).
